import pandas as pd, json
df=pd.read_pickle('cap3.pkl')
m=df[df.captured_at_utc.str.startswith('2026-05-06')]
out=[]
P=out.append
P(f"total rows={len(df)}")
P(f"rows 2026-05-06 UTC={len(m)}")
P(f"rows 2026-03-02 UTC={(df.captured_at_utc.str.startswith('2026-03-02')).sum()}")
P(f"May6 first={m.captured_at_utc.min()} last={m.captured_at_utc.max()}")
pm=m.captured_at_utc.str[:16].value_counts()
P(f"peak minute={pm.idxmax()} count={pm.max()}")
P(f"2nd peak={pm.index[1]} {pm.iloc[1]}")
P(f"minutes with >=5000 captures={(pm>=5000).sum()}")
P(f"distinct target_url all={df.target_url.nunique()} May6={m.target_url.nunique()}")
P(f"collection values={df.collection.value_counts().to_dict()}")
P(f"status all={df.indexed_http_status.value_counts().to_dict()}")
P(f"status May6={m.indexed_http_status.value_counts().to_dict()}")
P(f"hosts={df.host.value_counts().to_dict()}")
P(f"categories={df.cat.value_counts().to_dict()}")
for c,s in df.groupby('cat'):
    P(f"cat {c}: status={s.indexed_http_status.value_counts().to_dict()}")
fg=df[df.cat=='DataDownloads/<year>/file guess']
P(f"fileguess rows={len(fg)} distinct urls={fg.target_url.nunique()} 302={(fg.indexed_http_status=='302').sum()} 200={(fg.indexed_http_status=='200').sum()} 200 distinct digests={fg[fg.indexed_http_status=='200'].archive_digest_sha1_base32.nunique()}")
P(f"302 rows with digest VQ4IHGHZ...={(df[df.indexed_http_status=='302'].archive_digest_sha1_base32=='VQ4IHGHZHSDSTX6QHI4HWHLXP4KIEQIN').sum()} of {(df.indexed_http_status=='302').sum()}")
fd=pd.read_pickle('fd.pkl')
P(f"FileDownload rows={(df.cat=='DataDownloads/FileDownload/<n>').sum()} numeric={len(fd)} min={fd.n.min()} max={fd.n.max()} distinct={fd.n.nunique()} missing_in_1_1000={[i for i in range(1,1001) if i not in set(fd.n)]}")
ok=fd[fd.indexed_http_status=='200']
P(f"FileDownload 200 rows={len(ok)} distinct ids={ok.n.nunique()} id range={ok.n.min()}-{ok.n.max()} by host={ok.host.value_counts().to_dict()} first={ok.captured_at_utc.min()}")
P(f"FileDownload 500 rows={(fd.indexed_http_status=='500').sum()}")
P(f"FileDownload 200 size min={ok.warc_record_length.astype(int).min()} max={ok.warc_record_length.astype(int).max()}")
cf=m[m.indexed_http_status.isin(['503','520','524'])]
for st,s in cf.groupby('indexed_http_status'): P(f"{st}: n={len(s)} first={s.captured_at_utc.min()} last={s.captured_at_utc.max()}")
d=json.load(open('@@THIMBLE_CORPUS@@/05-maryland/response-excerpts.json'))
P(f"response-excerpts entries={len(d)} schools={[e['metadata']['school_id'] for e in d]}")
for i,l in enumerate(out,1): print(f"L{i}: {l}")
EOF
